topics.title: VicaEmpa CKD Ph III EASi-KIDNEY (1378-0006) 招募红灯

background.text: VicaEmpa CKD Ph III（1378-0006）红灯自2025年4月起。FSS于2025年8月24日，但尚无患者随机化，较原始时间线（2025年4月30日）延迟约4个月。13个站点激活，38例患者筛选，无患者随机化。LSR仍计划于2026年8月30日。全球也出现延迟，除台湾（88例）外，东亚国家尚无患者随机化。
background.quote:
FSS(First Subject Screen) took place on 24th Aug, 2025, while no subject was randomized yet. Overall delay is ~ 4 months vs. original timeline(30th Apr, 2025)
13 sites activated with 38 patients screened, while no patient randomized yet
LSR(Last Subject Randomised) was still scheduled on 30th Aug, 2026
A global delay also occurred, and except Taiwan(88), no East Asian countries has randomized patients yet

background.text: 时间线持续延迟，剩余招募窗口缩短；预期受试者和终点事件减少，可能影响中国亚组结果和适应症批准。
background.quote:
Continuously delayed timeline, and shortened recruitment window left
Fewer subjects and endpoint events are expected,  potentially impacting Chinese subgroup result and indication approval

background.text: VicaEmpa CKD开发计划：Ph III 1378-0006（FSS 2025年6月，DBL 2027年1月，批准2029年1月）；Ph II 1378-0023（FSS 2025年8月，DBL 2027年9月，批准2028年8月）。22例患者随机化，26个站点启动，中国12例患者随机化。CTP3.0于2025年11月24日通过HAI提交。
background.quote:
22 patients randomised，26 sites initiated
12 patients randomized in China
CTP3.0 submitted on 24 Nov through HAI

background.text: Oxford当前计划：让招募持续至至少1100例患者随机化；预计整体延迟长达6个月，这也为中国增加了招募时间。
background.quote:
The current plan by Oxford is to let recruitment continue until at least 1,100 patients are randomized.
According to Martina, it is expected the overall delay will be as long as 6 months, this also adds time for China for recruitment

todo.quote:
Monthly regular catch-up with CTL is ongoing to monitor trial progress
Global Medical and global brand team have been fully informed, and aware of the current situation, and will also look into the delay issue.
